## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. State any change to supported coverage or schema contracts.

## Verification

List checks actually run and meaningful limits. For a new runtime check, include a synthetic vulnerable fixture and secure counterpart. For guidance-only changes, describe any manual evaluation separately from automated tests.

## Privacy

Confirm that the diff and attachments contain no credentials, private assessment reports, customer records, or private application source. Use the private vulnerability reporting channel for security disclosures.
